### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/data/filter-subtree-provenance.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component-type-vocabulary.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object), FormSectionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`  _(via REACT_BLOCKS (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via FormSectionSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ActionParamSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ActionParamSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/data/filter-subtree-provenance.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component-type-vocabulary.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5282ad8d830a1f5006264885f9baff5802cc5a5a` — the merge of head `1b885d3c277b668ac4d9c1533b65dc436204ed2a` into base `f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5282ad8d830a1f5006264885f9baff5802cc5a5a && git checkout 5282ad8d830a1f5006264885f9baff5802cc5a5a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243 1b885d3c277b668ac4d9c1533b65dc436204ed2a && git checkout -B drift-repro f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243 && git merge --no-ff 1b885d3c277b668ac4d9c1533b65dc436204ed2a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f572a7eb3c272a5be85e3ec64d2516c944c3b243` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1b885d3c277b668ac4d9c1533b65dc436204ed2a`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #20234 (body; every comment: triage `5856637615` and the ruling it points at, `5749154545` on #19123; the seat-2 pointer `5858331362`; stage 1's claim `5859418643`, report `5860236501`, ACCEPT `5860414140` and landing `5860571318`; stage 2's claim `5860586561`, report `5861177436`, record `5861396181`, ACCEPT `5861418146` and landing `5861600944`; stage 3's claim `5876941555`, report `5881236928`, record `5881413052` on PR #20533, ACCEPT `5881425268` and landing `5881658422`; stage 4's claim `5881696480`, report `5882273687`, record `5882405617` on PR #20548, ACCEPT `5882433819`, the census hand-over `5882628946` and landing `5882686893`; the stage-5 claim `5882723856` and report `5883647445`), PR #20576 (body, its one comment `5883617608`, the 27-file list, the four commits and the net diff against the merge base `dee9b26f6c`, read from the local ref at the head above with `-U0` and the head blobs for enclosure), the 23 cited commits (message and stat for all; the diff wherever the message does not name the number or the line claims more than the subject), PR #16788 for the #16626 association, `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:380-400`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` and `scripts/adr-anchors/` for the 25 numbers, the landed citation grammar in `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` on `origin/main` (`KNOWN_REPOSITORIES`, `PROSE_QUALIFIER_RE`, `CITATION_RE`, `namesThisRepository`, the judged and deferred surfaces), `lint.yml`'s job roster, `pr-automation.yml`'s WHICH LEVEL, `packages/spec/package.json` files[], and `content/docs/references/**` at the head for the removed fragments. Nothing was built, run or re-run: the diff was read with git, the anchors with git show, the numbers with grep, and the tracker numbers with REST GET against this repository and objectui (a GitHub read, not a local run). The check-runs were read for judgment once, at 2026-09-29T04:31Z.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Scope and file surface: right.** 27 files: 23 `.ts` files under `packages/spec/src/ui/**`, `packages/spec/src/data/filter-subtree-provenance.ts`, `packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts`, the generated `content/docs/references/ui/expression-bindable-text-keys.mdx` (+2/-2) and the new `.changeset/spec-ui-provenance-anchors.md` (+14). Every `.ts` file is on the claim's surface; the claim's one exclusion, `ui/view-grouping-query.ts`, is byte-identical base to head (blob `3923dc3c1`). The dev deviation at `manifest-collection-spelling.ts:67` (#10485) is inside the surface: the claim's file surface is "comment and docblock lines that cite a tracker number answering 404" in the files it names, and it names this file; the hand-over's `:71` is the site the census found, not a fence around the other lines of the same seven-line comment (`:67-:73`); `#10485` answers 404 here; the rewrite takes stage 1's anchor for that number (`35ad101bc`, whose message says it dropped exactly this `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` fold), the same anchor this PR gives `ui/index.ts:51`, `interaction-config-retirement.test.ts:116` and `widget-i18n-retirement.test.ts:112`; no other claim holds the file. Leaving `:67` dead beside a re-anchored `:71` would have been the deviation. `origin/main` (`f572a7eb3c`) is one commit past the merge base and moves none of the 27 files, so the net diff judged here is the diff against current `main`; GitHub reads `mergeable: true`. No governed surface is touched; 198 changed lines; the head repository is the base repository; first line `Part of #20234`, no closing keyword; `Clause-②: no` on the body's second line.

**(b) Comment-only, no test string or code token moves: right.** `git diff -U0` over the 25 `.ts` files: 90 lines added, 90 removed, and every one of the 180 begins with `//`, ` *` or `/**`. Enclosure read on the head blobs: each ` *` line sits under an open `/**` with no `*/` between, and each `//` line stands outside any template literal. One backtick-parity flag, `component.zod.ts:5457`, traces to backtick pairs split across the `//` comments at `:5336-5337` and `:5351-5352`; `:5457` itself is the `//` run between the `object-tree` and `object-timeline` rows of `ComponentPropsMap`. Every file keeps its line count, 25 of 25. So no string literal, `it`/`describe` title, `.describe()` text or code token is on any changed line; the 21 dead-number test titles the dev lists stay as strings, which is the claim's rule. Three changed lines held no dead number and are the second half of a rewritten sentence (`action.zod.ts:400`, `action-param-carryover.test.ts:13`, `expression-bindable-text-keys.test.ts:119`), all comment text inside the 90-for-90 balance. The dev's parser-level token comparison is not re-run and not needed for that verdict.

**(c) Numbers: right.** Over the whole diff, added-minus-removed tracker numbers is empty for every one of the 27 files; net-removed is exactly the dev's 25 numbers, 87 sites (85 in the `.ts` files, the dev's 84 comment sites plus the slash-joined `#9972` at `component.test.ts:3612`, and the two `objectstack#13670` / `objectstack#13672` lines in the mdx). No `PR #N` stands on any added line; the three `objectui#` joined spellings are the only qualified citations added. REST `issues/N` without redirects, 2026-09-29T04:38Z: all 25 numbers answer 404 here, and so do `#6111`, `#8758` and `pulls/8758`; lit control `#16862` 200, dead control `#16714` 404. The this-repository numbers that stand on added lines answer 200: `#12183` (`component-type-vocabulary.ts:4`) and `#9397` (`component.zod.ts:2213`) in judged files, `#15828`, `#9881`, `#11992` and `#2555` in deferred test files; `#146` is a decision-batch ordinal (`NON_CITATION_HEADS`). The dev's census over 400 numbers is otherwise not re-run.

**(d) Anchor truth: right, 23 of 23.** 23 distinct sha-shaped tokens stand on added lines and none on removed lines (the `82a94170c` on both sides of `component.test.ts:3612` is the former objectui pin in unchanged text, not an anchor). `git rev-parse --disambiguate` answers exactly one object for each; `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exits 0 for all 23 against `origin/main` `f572a7eb3c`; every one is a single-parent commit; the repository is not shallow. 22 of 23 name the number they replace in their own message or diff (the message for 17; the diff alone for `e854a531a`, `0e4e51b0a`, `225e7690f`, `c459da6bc` and `5383fa670`; #8836 through `1850ebbb0`'s diff beside #8794 in its message). Read beyond the subject, against the line each now anchors:
- `78f0be872` for #6276 (`component.zod.ts:34`, `:165`, `:568`, `:2455`, `:2546`, `:2554`, `component.test.ts:2126`): PR #6624's squash for card #6276, message "Maintainer ruling 2026-08-08, direction A, the #5611 rule applied again", declares `element:record_picker`'s flat `sort` / `limit` from `ElementDataSourceSchema`'s own shapes, and its own `component.zod.ts` diff wrote "enumerate by the RENDERER'S read pattern, not by the key list a previous ruling quoted", the lesson `:568` cites. True of every site.
- `e233db9db` for #17987 (nine sites): "Fixes #17987", "Executes the objectui#8652 maintainer ruling, reply verbatim 「B」", declares `navigation` on `object-kanban` / `object-calendar` by reference to `ListViewSchema.navigation` and gives `object-timeline` its `ComponentPropsMap` row. The kanban/calendar/timeline sites, the `ComponentPropsMap` row site (`:5457`) and the test header are each about one of those three acts. True.
- `adabccf5f` for #18177 (`bulk-action.zod.ts:51`, `:169`, `:262`, `bulk-action.test.ts:61`, `:307`): "Fixes #18177", "Executes decision batch #146 item 4, letter A", `BulkActionParamSchema` strict and declaring `dependsOn`. The lines say exactly that. True.
- `d5552ca13` for #9933 (`view.zod.ts:2517`, `:5060`, `:5086`, `:5118`, `:5513`, `view-metadata-schema.test.ts:398`, `:410`): PR #9996's squash for card #9933, admits `columnState` on the overlay faces and keeps every authoring door rejecting it by name with a runtime-only prescription; its own `view.zod.ts` diff wrote the "explicitly out of #9933's scope" clause `:5086` rewrites, and the `:410` claim (before it, this body carried no declared key) is the change it made. True.
- `5383fa670` for #11284 (`react-blocks.ts:39`, `:94`, `:109`, `:295`, `react-blocks.test.ts:139`): the message names no number; its changeset heads "(#11284, maintainer ruling 2026-08-23)", its `react-blocks.ts` diff writes "deprecate-first (maintainer ruling 2026-08-23)" and publishes `objectName` / `viewType` as deprecated aliases, the aliases `:94` and `:109` describe. True, dated as the lines say.
- `30b099078` for #16626 (`component.test.ts:2336`): the one anchor whose message and diff name no #16626. The line describes "the door the family was sequenced behind": objectui#7754's array-analytics lowering reaching the shipped console. The commit is that door by its own content: its subject is "bump the objectui pin to 53ded82bf7a4, the shipped console lowers array analytics filters", its `.objectui-sha` diff moves `a472b07167a3` to `53ded82bf7a4`, and its body carries objectui#7754. PR #16788 (200) reads "Fixes #16626", its `merge_commit_sha` is `30b099078`, and its body says the bump ships objectui#7754's lowering. So the line names the commit that did what it says, which is ruling C's commit rung; the association to the dead card rests on the PR record rather than the commit's own text. This is not the stage-3 #11065 shape, where the commit's own diff named the number; it is the stage-2 `94c930248` shape, a commit tied to its card through another record, which that record passed. No other commit on `origin/main` decides it: the only two that name #16626 are the sweep commits `66e266c93` and `9e9bb4641`, and the string entered the tree with `4792049f6` (#17257), the family landing the line sits in, which is the sequenced act, not the door. True anchor; the optional link is under ③.
- The rest, each read: `97e7e3caa` (#5970) gives `visible` its boolean arm; `1850ebbb0` (#8794 / #8836) corrects the reuse-safety claim from the #8794 survey and adds the `[#8836]` pins, writing `filter-subtree-provenance.ts:131` itself; `60e0f900a` (#9972) is the `page:tabs` `items[].icon` accept-pin, re-verified at pin `82a94170c` as `:3612` says; `2306a765c` (#10194) ends the `/meta/theme` store-anything branch (its message: "currently store any JSON as success:true"); `d1ba685ec` (#10274) "Fixes #10274", re-measures the four pin citations and gates the class; `35ad101bc` (#10485) retires the `themes` carrier and `ThemeSchema` whole, ruled B 2026-08-21; `ece4dad31` (#11350) records the 2026-08-23 nameability ruling; `88b9d749a` (#11507) and `1a6a19c31` (#11658) are the ruling's declaration and its execution (both "direction 4"); `5cb62d88b` (#11703) makes `clone_permission_set` carry all five facets, the silent drop the lines name; `0e4e51b0a` (#11753) is `carryOver`, its diff naming the 2026-08-25 ruling (recommendation A) and the `visible: false` measured non-answer `:398` cites; `311433f6b` (#12194) declares the item-name grammar, `QUALIFIED_ITEM_NAME_PATTERN` in its diff; `c459da6bc` (#12868) narrows `default` out of the form-view options and its changeset carries the "measured ZERO occurrences" census `:2966` cites; `225e7690f` (#12950) created `component-type-vocabulary.ts` and records the `global:search` / `global:notifications` readiness read; `fd289be45` (#13156) is the A-half strip of tracker ids from function-declaration refusal prose, its diff writing both "#13156's strip" lines; `8c6a7fc0b` (#13670) records the ruling that `text`'s channel is `content` alone; `e854a531a` (#13672) narrows the `button` row and records `action:button` / `ui:button` as deliberately out. None is a sha that merely touched the number in passing.
Rung: no ADR, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` or `scripts/adr-anchors/` file records the decision behind any of the 24 commit-anchored numbers (ADR-0126 cites #11703 and #11753 as references at `:318`, `:320`, `:430-431`, not as the record of the carry-over ruling), so the commit rung is the right rung for all 23 shas, as in stages 1 to 4.

**(e) `dashboard.zod.ts:686`, ADR-0087 as the citation: right.** The removed line quoted the ADR's own heading, `「Amended 2026-09-13 (#18003) — the level half」`; `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:390` on `origin/main` reads `**Amended 2026-09-13 (#18003) — the level half.**`. The added line, `(ADR-0087, its 2026-09-13 amendment, 「the level half」)`, is true of that text: the amendment is dated 2026-09-13, "the level half" is its verbatim title fragment, and the paragraph it introduces says what the docblock claims (the npm level is a second axis; every "major" in that section is a protocol major; the level a changeset declares is the npm version of the lockstep group). Form C's first rung is "the ADR or ruling record when one exists"; the record exists and stays the citation, and the dead number leaves. The ADR's own heading still carries #18003, a governed surface and #20556's carrier, not this card's.

**(f) The three respellings: right.** `view.zod.ts:3634` `objectui#6110 + objectui#6111`: `#6111` answers 404 here and objectui's #6111 (200) is "Authored `FormSection.visibleWhen` is dropped by all four plugin-form layouts", the section-level `current_user` scope question the docblock's heading names, beside objectui#6110 (200, the evaluators passing an undefined scope). `component.zod.ts:3479` and `:4140` `objectui#8221's PR objectui#8758`: `#8758` answers 404 here as an issue and as a pull; objectui's PR 8758 (200) is "retire the legacy string `sort` clause — one spelling, the array (objectui#8221)", merged 2026-09-09T05:21Z, which is what both sentences say it does. Under the landed grammar the old spellings were this repository's: `PROSE_QUALIFIER_RE` matches only a known name followed by whitespace and an optional `PR` / `issue` ending immediately before the `#`, so `objectui#8221's PR #8758` (with `#8221's` between) and the bare second number of `+ #6111` fall to `CITATION_RE` as bare and are judged here, dead (the self-test at `:1341` pins the pair case). The joined `objectui#N` form resolves through `KNOWN_REPOSITORIES` to objectui, so each respelled number now names its board, and PR #20554 made the same fix at `data/field.zod.ts:370`. The three prose sites left as they stand (`view.zod.ts:2354`, `:2579`, `view.test.ts:426`, each `objectui PR #8758`) are read by that grammar as objectui's: `PROSE_QUALIFIER_RE` names them, the header's own measurement calls exactly these three "census deaths here that are not deaths at all", and the self-test at `:1333-1336` pins `objectui PR #N` as cross-repo. Leaving them is right.

**(g) The generated page: right.** `content/docs/references/ui/expression-bindable-text-keys.mdx:77` and `:94` are the `expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts:72` and `:89` substitutions verbatim with the ` * ` prefix stripped; the surrounding 25 lines of the module docblock and the page agree line for line except the generator's own `{@link expressionBindableTextKeysFor}` rendering on an unchanged line, so the page reads as generator output, not a hand edit. No other page under `content/docs/references/` at the head carries any of the 25 numbers or a removed fragment. `check:docs` runs in `Type Check · source gates` (`lint.yml`, the artifact-gate steps beside `check:authorable-surface` and the spec pin-citation check), success at the read, which is the generator's own verdict that the committed page equals its output at this head.

**(h) Form C over the whole diff: right.** Each rewrite leads with `commit 9-hex` (or `[commit 9-hex]` where the marker form stood) and says in words what was decided; the one ADR site keeps the ADR; no tracker number or `PR #N` is added. The citation gate judges `packages/**/src/**/*.ts` as comment prose and defers `packages/**/*.test.ts`, so the 11 non-test files (`action.zod.ts`, `bulk-action.zod.ts`, `component-type-vocabulary.ts`, `component.zod.ts`, `dashboard.zod.ts`, `expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts`, `index.ts`, `react-blocks.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `filter-subtree-provenance.ts`, `manifest-collection-spelling.ts`) are in its population and the 14 test files are not; the added-minus-removed count in (c) covers the 14. Nothing author-shown is touched (no `.describe()`, refusal or migration-entry text), so form D does not arise.

### ② Semver level

`patch` for `@objectstack/spec` is right and `Clause-②: no` is right. The package ships bytes from this diff: `files[]` carries `dist` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the six touched `.zod.ts` sources (`action`, `bulk-action`, `component`, `dashboard`, `expression-bindable-text-keys`, `view`) ship verbatim with their rewritten comments, and the other docblocks reach `dist` through the bundle. (b) shows no export, key, value or type moves, so nothing widens or narrows: WHICH LEVEL (`pr-automation.yml`, the 2026-09-04 ruling on #15294) keeps a change that moves no public surface at `patch`, the level stages 1 (`21ab410417`), 2 (`5cf58eb164`), 3 (`03b19d9cfd`) and 4 (`6154165484`) took for the same act. The changeset names one package, describes only the comment re-anchoring, carries no tracker number and no model identifier, and `Check Changeset` is success at the read.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. `manifest-collection-spelling.ts:67` beyond the hand-over's `:71`: inside the surface, judged in (a); the PR body names it.

9. The verify-lock queue timeout and the setsid PID reads: not a verdict; no other process was signalled.
